fixes.title: Primary-athlete binding reports an inseparable second surfer as ambiguous instead of a silent tie-break
fixes.root_cause: pipeline/perception/runtime._best_primary ranks tracks by a composite with a single timeless crop hint; two surfers crossing at the hint tie and max() picks one silently
fixes.change: _binding_separability: runner-up that is a different body (median IoU < 0.3 over shared frames), co-present for >= 25% of the bound track's window, as close to the hint (<= 0.06, within 0.03) and within 10% on the ranking -> track_binding_status=ambiguous, actor_tracking_status=ambiguous (-> PRIMARY_ACTOR_UNCLEAR via primary_actor_policy). Every event also records track_binding_status / runner_up / evidence.
fixes.commit: this cycle (see git log: primary-athlete binding ambiguity)
fixes.before: P5 bound track 1 with no flag; real windows: n/a
fixes.after: P5 ambiguous + PRIMARY_ACTOR_UNCLEAR; P1-P4, P6-P8 unchanged; 0/166 real windows newly blocked
fixes.limits: Crop hints are not exported to diagnostics, so the replay uses the bound track's position at the event middle as the hint (proxy). The co-presence condition was added after seeing 0104 in run 43583126199: development data, not holdout. No real crossing case exists in GT-v1, so the blocking branch is synthetic-only (SIMULATED, not MEDIA_VERIFIED).
